name: Chess queen (crown bowl)
assumptions: The crown's points are left out: they need milling, so the crown is a smooth dome-and-bowl shape instead
Keeping the given Ø45 x 134 bar, 104 mm stickout, as supplied
The dome is filled flat at the rim's top edge (Z-11, Ø14) for the profile, with the 3 mm bowl then cut into that shoulder by the face-grooving tool, per the skill's face-groove convention
Rim wall kept at Ø28 down to Z-15 (1 mm past the bowl's deepest point) so the bowl keeps at least 1 mm of outside wall, before the crown narrows to Ø18
Bowl: 3 mm deep, from Ø14 at the dome to Ø25 at the rim's inner wall, leaving about 1.5 mm of rim wall at the top (rim OD Ø28)
Added a 1.6 mm flat at the bottom of the crown's narrowing curve (Z-24 to Z-25.6, Ø18) to avoid a sharp notch before the collar
The bowl's rise back to the rim's inner wall uses a flatter arc (R15) so it doesn't curl into an undercut
No keyway, engraving or thread requested, so none added
